params.name: ad_account_id
params.description: It is the Pinterest ad account ID, and it travels in the path.
params.fix_hint: Put the ad account ID in the path as `/v5/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/events`.

params.name: test
params.description: The optional test query parameter selects test mode.

params.name: data
params.description: The vendor documents the JSON shape or value type of this field.

params.name: data[]
params.description: The vendor documents the JSON shape or value type of this field.
The published event or batch envelope is a JSON object.

params.name: event_name
params.description: It is the conversion event name. Pinterest documents a set of standard names and also allows a custom name of up to 100 characters.
params.fix_hint: Send a documented name such as `checkout`, or a custom name mapped to a standard event in Ads Manager.

params.name: action_source
params.description: It is the platform the event was ingested from. Pinterest documents `web`, `app_android`, `app_ios`, and `offline`.
params.fix_hint: Send `web`, `app_android`, `app_ios`, or `offline`. Pinterest spells `web` in lower case, unlike Snap.

params.name: event_id
params.description: It identifies the event for deduplication against the Pinterest tag.
params.fix_hint: Send a stable id per conversion, such as an order number.

params.name: event_time
params.description: Pinterest documents a Unix timestamp in seconds. A 13-digit value is milliseconds.
params.fix_hint: Send seconds, not milliseconds: divide a JavaScript `Date.now()` by 1000 and floor it.

params.name: user_data
params.description: Pinterest requires a `user_data` object, and it must include at least one of `em`, `hashed_maids`, or an IP and user agent pair.
params.fix_hint: Add `user_data` with a hashed email, hashed MAIDs, or `client_ip_address` and `client_user_agent`.

params.name: user_data.em
params.description: Email must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: user_data.em[]
params.description: Every email in the list must be lowercased and SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Hash each address with SHA-256 and send the hex digest.

params.name: user_data.ph
params.description: Phone must be digits-only with country code, then SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Strip symbols, keep the country code, hash with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: user_data.external_id
params.description: External IDs must be SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Hash the customer id with SHA-256 and send the hex digest.

params.name: user_data.client_ip_address
params.description: It is the visitor IP address, sent unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the browser's public IP, not a digest.

params.name: user_data.client_user_agent
params.description: It is the visitor user agent, sent unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the browser's user agent string, not a digest.

params.name: user_data.hashed_maids
params.description: Hashed GAID or IDFA. Pinterest documents SHA-256.
params.fix_hint: Hash the MAID with SHA-256 and send the hex digest.

params.name: user_data.hashed_maids[]
params.description: Every MAID in the list must be SHA-256 hashed.
params.fix_hint: Hash each MAID with SHA-256 and send the hex digest.

params.name: custom_data.currency
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

params.name: custom_data.value
params.description: It is the total monetary value of purchased items. Pinterest documents a string parsed as a double, with no negatives, and currency whenever it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Send the pre-tax, pre-shipping total in `custom_data.value` as a number, such as `66.95`.

params.name: custom_data.content_ids
params.description: It is a product ID related to the event. Pinterest documents an array of IDs that also appear on `custom_data.contents`.
params.fix_hint: Send catalog IDs in `custom_data.content_ids`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.content_ids[]
params.description: Every listed ID is a product ID related to the event.
params.fix_hint: Send catalog IDs in `custom_data.content_ids`, or drop empty entries.

params.name: custom_data.content_name
params.description: It is the name of the page or product associated with the event.
params.fix_hint: Send the page or product name in `custom_data.content_name`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.content_category
params.description: It is the type of merchandise. Pinterest documents `content_category` on the product event table.
params.fix_hint: Send the merchandise type in `custom_data.content_category`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.content_brand
params.description: It is the brand of merchandise. Pinterest documents `content_brand` on the product event table.
params.fix_hint: Send the brand in `custom_data.content_brand`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.num_items
params.description: It is the total number of products involved, for example items purchased in a checkout.
params.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.num_items`, such as `2`.

params.name: custom_data.order_id
params.description: It identifies the order in a purchase-related event.
params.fix_hint: Send the order id in `custom_data.order_id`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.search_string
params.description: It is the string entered in a search event.
params.fix_hint: Send the query in `custom_data.search_string`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.opt_out_type
params.description: It is the privacy opt-out type. Pinterest documents `ldp` as the only accepted value for limited data processing.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.opt_out_type` to `ldp`, or drop the pair.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].id
params.description: It is the product ID of an individual merchandise item.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].id` to the catalog item ID, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].item_name
params.description: It is the product name of an individual merchandise item.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].item_name` to the product name, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].item_category
params.description: It is the product category of an individual merchandise item.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].item_category` to the category, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].item_brand
params.description: It is the brand of an individual merchandise item.
params.fix_hint: Set `custom_data.contents[].item_brand` to the brand, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].item_price
params.description: It is the price of one merchandise item (single quantity). Pinterest documents it as a string parsed as a number.
params.fix_hint: Send `custom_data.contents[].item_price` as a number, such as `19.99`. Put the order total in `custom_data.value`.

params.name: custom_data.contents[].quantity
params.description: It is the quantity of that merchandise item selected by the user.
params.fix_hint: Send a whole number in `custom_data.contents[].quantity`, such as `2`.

rules.message: A `checkout` event is missing `custom_data.value` or `custom_data.currency`. Pinterest documents both as recommended for checkout.
rules.fix_hint: Send the checkout total and a three-letter currency code.

rules.message: The event carries `custom_data.value` with no `custom_data.currency`. Pinterest documents currency as required whenever value is sent.
rules.fix_hint: Add `custom_data.currency` as a three-letter code alongside the value.

rules.message: `user_data` carries none of the identifiers Pinterest requires. Send `em`, `hashed_maids`, or `client_ip_address` with `client_user_agent`.
rules.fix_hint: Add a hashed email, hashed MAIDs, or the IP and user agent pair.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. Pinterest requires `user_data.em` to be a SHA-256 hex digest.
rules.fix_hint: Lowercase the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but Pinterest documents `client_ip_address` and `client_user_agent` as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address or user agent. Hashing it makes the event unmatchable.

rules.message: Pinterest forbids a pure zero IPv4 matching address.
Pinterest forbids placeholder user agent values Other and null.
Pinterest documents that event_time cannot be later than receipt of the request.
